locked_conventions.source_domain: h_lambda is defined on [-lambda,lambda] with Lebesgue measure and is zero-extended
locked_conventions.source_normalization: a4=sqrt(3)/2^(11/4); h_lambda tends to h=(pi/2)*x^2*(2*pi*x^2-3)*exp(-pi*x^2), not to a unit-normalized substitute
locked_conventions.finite_state: k_lambda^+=(E(h_lambda)+J*E(h_lambda))/2; inversion evenness is imposed by this average and is not assumed for k_lambda
locked_conventions.matrix_assembly: form the complete Q=pole-archimedean-prime matrix with every prime power n<=lambda^2 before extracting the ground projector, residual, gap, cofactor, or pole leverage
locked_conventions.half_paired_trace: Z_0=sum_(k=1)^N rho_k^(-2); the trace over both roots is not substituted
locked_conventions.limiting_transform: hat(E(h)(exp(.)))(z)=Xi(z)/4 in the printed source normalization
locked_conventions.parameter_ingestion: decimal source parameters are parsed directly and never through binary64
locked_conventions.secret_boundary: API keys and environment secrets are neither read nor serialized

locked_formulas.origin_modes: ell_0(phi_0)=sqrt(L), ell_0(phi_n)=0 for n!=0; ell_2(phi_0)=L^(5/2)/24, ell_2(phi_n)=L^(5/2)/(4*pi^2*n^2) for n!=0
locked_formulas.anchor_schedule: delta_lambda=O(lambda^(-2)) and N/L^(7/5)->infinity imply the normalized anchor origin two-jet limit
locked_formulas.anchor_coefficient_rate: the normalized projected anchor satisfies <z_N,kappa>/kappa_0=O(L^(-2)) when the two-jet schedule holds and N/L^2 is bounded away from zero
locked_formulas.relative_response_target: on N/L^2 bounded below, bounded Z_0 is equivalent up to the explicit fixed-height sandwich to A(L/(4*pi))/A(0)=O(L*exp(-L/4))
locked_formulas.residual_gap_gate: for B=A-U*I>0, r=norm(b), gamma=lambda_min(B), r/gamma=O(L^(-5/2)) suffices for bounded true-ground origin curvature; little-o identifies the anchor limit
locked_formulas.one_solve_gate: tau_U=norm(B^(-1)*b)=O(L^(-5/2)) suffices for bounded true-ground origin curvature; little-o identifies the anchor limit
locked_formulas.orientation_sharpness: B=gamma*I with b parallel to the origin-Wronskian Riesz vector makes the L^(-5/2) residual-gap power sharp without orientation information
locked_formulas.normalization_rejection: unit-normalizing h_lambda multiplies the unnormalized limiting transform and a_infinity by 2^(17/4)/sqrt(33) and is rejected; the normalized anchor kappa and its K_0,K_2 jets are scale-invariant because that scalar cancels

locked_domains.anchor_two_jet: lambda tends to infinity, delta_lambda=O(lambda^(-2)) in the source normalization, and N/L^(7/5) tends to infinity
locked_domains.anchor_coefficient_rate: the anchor two-jet domain plus N/L^2 bounded away from zero, so the finite exterior inverse-square tail is O(L^(-2)) after rescaling
locked_domains.fixed_height_trace: simple inversion-even ground, nonzero source boundary scalar, x_0/c>0, and positive shifted odd block, so every rho_k is real and positive
locked_domains.pole_cofactor: T_+=Q_+-epsilon*I has a one-dimensional kernel and a positive complement; Q is complete before adjugation
locked_domains.ground_transfer: the anchor two-jet domain holds so abs(K_0) is bounded below and abs(K_2/K_0) is bounded; B=A-U*I is rigorously positive with a positive lower enclosure for gamma, and a nonpositive enclosure is a failure
